assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: genuinely transparent embroidered cloud overlay for the attached coastal wedding illustration. Generate ONE isolated LOW, LONG, WIND-SWEPT CLOUD, with a delicate narrow horizontal silhouette, three uneven wispy tails and open notches between thin cloud tufts. Much flatter and more asymmetrical than a puffy three-hump cartoon cloud. Wide 3:1 composition, a little clear margin, entire subject visible. Match the reference's fine shallow cotton-thread embroidery: warm ivory stitches, pale oatmeal thread shadows, occasional faint dusty-blue stitches underneath, muted low contrast and fine sewn irregular edges. Clear little parallel thread ridges. Soft and elegant; the sky must not be included. Actual alpha transparency everywhere around and through the cloud, no blue/cream sky patch, no linen rectangle, no shadow rectangle, fake checkerboard, text, border or watermark. Only one cloud, no sheet or collection.
